column1: # Indices are one-based positions in tools/sources/ui-round8-harvest.json, so a key can never differ
# from what the game rendered. The last six entries of the harvest that need a new value:
#   2   Meru answering the commander (the mail/affection line that follows the "assistant" exchange)
#   3   end-of-period stamp; the value needs one '#' per digit run, which is five here
#   5   shown instead of the event banner once the period is over
#   39  present items handed out by the Random Present Box

column2: My habit of focusing so hard that I lose sight of everything around me... Now I can take it in a positive way. That's thanks to you, too.
